svg.text: TB2-H HEAVY · tandem wing (B) + wide blended body (D)
Length ≈ 80 m · span ≈ 64 m · body width ≈ 26 m
6 tilting ducted fans Ø14 m on side booms; fans also cruise propulsors (no jets)
Gross 200 t VTOL / 270 t STO · empty ≈ 156 t · cruise ≈ 330 kn
Hold: 4 × 20 ft containers (2 × 2) · downwash ≈ 45 m/s
VTOL payload up to 2,500 m / 40 °C: ≈ 36 t (300 km) / ≈ 12 t (1,500 km)
STO payload: ≈ 105 t (300 km) / ≈ 72 t (1,500 km)
Role: bulk to forward strip, VTOL shuttle into site
TB2-F FAST · bigger-span wing (A) + three-surface H-tail (C)
Length ≈ 70 m · span ≈ 62 m (folds to ≈ 42 m) · canard / H-tail ≈ 34 m
6 tilting ducted fans Ø10 m (feathered in cruise) + 2 dorsal turbofans ≈160 kN
Gross 100 t VTOL / 125 t STO · empty ≈ 83 t · cruise ≈ 420 kn (M0.7)
Hold: 2 × 20 ft containers in line · downwash ≈ 44 m/s
VTOL payload up to 2,500 m / 40 °C: ≈ 14 t (300 km) / ≈ 5 t (1,500 km)
STO payload: ≈ 39 t (300 km) / ≈ 28 t (1,500 km)
Role: rapid response, crews, medical, light vehicles
